verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Buzz exposes relay, REST and admin APIs, so API versioning and deprecation policy are fair questions. The only signal is a '/api/admin/v1' path prefix and a note that token auth was removed, and neither is a documented versioning scheme or deprecation policy. The probes found no OpenAPI spec, and nothing in the pack describes deprecation windows, sunset notices or compatibility guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
